name: Oskar
self_text: I am a non-binary Indian person in my mid 20s who spends free time playing chess online. I use a Canon camera and love how photography captures a single moment in time. Most weeks I can do Saturday afternoon. I am honestly just looking for a structured instruction session, and I am cool with taking portraits of each other. Fair warning, no gear debates is my thing.

requests.request_text: I need you to be available Saturday afternoon and you have to be into a structured instruction session. I'd strongly prefer that we have no gear debates or that gear talk is fine but not the point, though I won't rule you out over it.
